best_idea: Gate NPC greetings on a per-player already-met bit so first meetings and repeat meetings draw from different personality-indexed line banks, with %tokens resolved after the pick.
decision_why: The first-meet/repeat gate is cheap, cosmetic and fits zones-as-data, but the met state must sit per (player, NPC) in the one ledger, not on the NPC as Arena does.
acceptance: Two players meet the same citizen: each gets a first-meet line once; a second visit by the same player gets a repeat line; a server test asserts the met-set is keyed by player id and NPC id and survives a zone chunk reload.
